calls.reason: The only evidence is Google's own report of 9 million monthly developers and rising token volume. That leans against the claim, but it does not separate paid demand from free use, so it cannot settle how much demand exists outside the two firms.

Ars Technica reports OpenAI's 2025 net loss near $39B, but about $30B was a one-off charge, leaving roughly $8B. There is no Anthropic figure, and nothing tests the 'only through financial engineering' part.

Huang says frontier labs are outgrowing their balance sheets, and NVIDIA set up financing platforms. But Alphabet's $39B quarterly operating cash flow cuts the other way, and the main customers and their funding needs are never identified.
The packet offers single examples: xAI's turbines at Colossus 2 and a planned Amazon gas plant in Texas. The set of sites he had seen is never identified, so 'basically every' cannot be checked.

CoreWeave's $626M Q2 net loss is one company's result. A secondary report that Midjourney is profitable cuts against the broad claim but has no defined figures, and the claim itself is largely a judgement about what is understood.

Two reports (Yahoo/Blockspace citing the WSJ, and Bisnow) say NVIDIA holds the facility lease. Bisnow adds that Anthropic and Lambda were too big a credit risk to be direct tenants, which backs the lease role and the credit-risk reason.
